build_note: Trinity Force first — Spellblade procs every Q for massive empowered auto. Muramana stacks fast with Q spam, dramatically increases sustained DPS mid-game. Never build pure crit on Ezreal — his Q autos proc on-hit effects. Ult across the map hits every grouped ARAM fight for free poke damage.
vs_tanks: Lord Dominik's Regards + Serylda's Grudge — double armor pen stack
vs_healing: Mortal Reminder replaces Lord Dominik's if 2+ sustain enemies — never run both
vs_burst: Immortal Shieldbow replaces Bloodthirster — shields during E blink escape
kit_notes: Q (Mystic Shot) applies Sheen/Spellblade AND applies on-hit effects (Muramana bonus). Stack Manamune to Muramana by spamming Q. Arcane Shift (E) is both gap-close and escape — time it carefully. W (Essence Flux) marks enemies for increased Q damage. R (Trueshot Barrage) is free damage on grouped ARAM fights — throw it early every fight.
aram_specific: Poke freely with Q — it has 1150 range and minimal mana cost after Muramana stacks. Ult at grouped enemies through walls and across map at start of every fight. Never be in melee range. Use E backward when engaged, not forward.
